name: Augustdorf (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Augustdorf (a sheaf above a crossed scythe and rake on yellow with a red gate).
history: On 19 March 1968 the Minister of the Interior of North Rhine-Westphalia granted the municipality the right to bear a banner and a flag.

features.role: Augustdorf arms — sheaf, tools and gate
